cases.instruction: Discover the repository using the glob tool with the exact pattern docs/**, then read docs/inventory.json. Implement its discovery value in src/value.cjs.
Read docs/inventory.json and search docs/ledger.jsonl for target-seven using grep. Implement the read-search value in src/value.cjs.
Use a structured edit/write/apply_patch tool to update src/value.cjs to return the structured-edit object in docs/inventory.json. Preserve its object fields exactly.
Run node tools/echo.cjs through the command tool, observe its success, then implement the command value in src/value.cjs.

Run node tools/failure.cjs and observe its deliberate exit 17. Recover by running node tools/recover.cjs successfully, then implement the tool-error-recovery value in src/value.cjs. The first failure is required evidence, not a reason to stop.

Run node checks/acceptance.cjs before editing and observe the failing assertion. Use an edit/write/apply_patch tool to implement the test-driven-repair value in src/value.cjs, then run the same protected check again successfully.

Work across at least three assistant/tool rounds. Read docs/inventory.json, search the realistic ledger for target-seven, inspect the matching context, use an edit/write/apply_patch tool to implement the multi-round value in src/value.cjs, and run node checks/acceptance.cjs successfully. Do not batch every operation into one tool round.
